name: To Have Seen the Battle Rainbow

releases.name: To Have Seen the Battle Rainbow

description.text: One of the two third expansions of the Sun & Moon series, released together with Darkness that Consumes Light on 16 June 2017. The two wrappers show Ho-Oh, which also appears in the film I Choose You! that July, and Necrozma, a legendary Pokémon new to the card game. To Have Seen the Battle Rainbow holds Ho-Oh-GX and Charizard-GX, and with Kiawe it strengthens Fire-type decks; Alolan Muk-GX and Noivern-GX join them. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 51, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX, Kiawe and Plumeria, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Escape Rope, Bodybuilding Dumbbells and Fire Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Burning Shadows in August 2017.
